'''Scott Hammond''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2000 Minneapolis tournament (5 December)]] on 5 December 2000 with [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|MWYHL]], according to Garrett Larson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1515">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-07-mirkwood-deadbody-styled1515/ mirkwood-deadbody-style], DeckTech (garrett "deadbody" larson, 7 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-07-mirkwood-deadbody-styled1515/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
